title: Why was my Dark Green Account enrollment verification rejected?
summary: Explains common causes of rejection for Dark Green Account enrollment verification (missing name/institution, missing term/status/undated or “in progress,” blurred/cropped/unreadable image, password-protected/inaccessible file, or unaccepted document type). Provides steps to obtain an official/system-generated doc with full name, institution, term, and status, resubmit a clear full-frame image/readable PDF (not password-protected) using the same upload flow, and notes verification is required per_semester for the active term.
